items.title: 'Frame-by-frame' AI-generated global illumination could be part of AMD's answer to DLSS 5 someday
items.excerpt: AMD researchers hand indirect lighting to a diffusion model frame by frame, using a temporal VAE with motion vectors to keep the generated illumination from flickering, then composite it over the direct-lit frame.

items.title: Legendary Zelda and Star Fox artist is "genuinely amazed" by AI even as he catches backlash from Nintendo fans
items.excerpt: Former Nintendo art director Takaya Imamura (Majora's Mask, Star Fox) shared a game prototype built with AI help and says he is amazed by the tech, despite heavy fan backlash.

items.title: Team Behind Popular Ocarina Of Time PC Port Admit To Using AI For Years And Now Fans Are Freaking Out About 'Vibecoded Slop'
items.excerpt: The Ship of Harkinian team says LLM-assisted code has been in the fan PC port for years; asked which version is free of LLM content, a dev said 'I don't know'.

items.title: After eighteen years of jaggedy bowling, a new mod bestows GTA 4 with DLSS and FSR support
items.excerpt: A new community mod adds DLSS and FSR upscaling to 2008's GTA IV, giving the game a sharper, modern AI-reconstructed image.

items.title: Starform's Lou Fasulo on staying at 26 people, AI-native development and who really funds a live game
items.excerpt: The Metalstorm studio head says AI gave his 26-person team more throughput, not new capability, and explains where AI-native development stops.

items.title: DLSS-NR-on-AMD Developer Delivers 74% Performance Boost On Radeon GPUs In A Single Day
items.excerpt: DLSS-NR-on-AMD Alpha 0.4.0 boosts Radeon performance by 74% in DLSS 5 neural rendering, pushing Cyberpunk 2077 from 30 to 50 fps at 3440x1440. Note: DLSS 5 modding thread overlaps prior coverage (open-source Vulkan reimplementation); curator should weigh as follow-up.

items.title: 도깨비의세계, 12가지 스킬로 진입장벽 낮춘다
items.excerpt: 카카오게임즈 신작 MMORPG 도깨비의세계(10월 8일 출시)는 AI 챗봇 '묘롱'이 이용자 플레이 데이터를 분석해 성장 방향을 안내, 초심자 진입장벽을 낮춘다.

items.title: 라인게임즈, CODE EXIT 스팀 테스트 모집
items.excerpt: Phase 8 Studio의 4인 협동 신작 CODE EXIT는 실시간 학습 AI와 사운드 디자인으로 심리적 압박을 구현했다. 9월 28일~10월 19일 스팀 플레이테스트, 2027년 1분기 얼리 액세스 목표.
